Subject: Acme discovery follow-up — billing / procurement questions

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a few items we need to qualify on the commercial path so we can pull together an accurate quote and a procurement packet for your finance team:

- Preferred commercial path: are you planning to purchase via corporate card, PO (purchase order), or via AWS Marketplace (consolidated cloud billing)?
- If PO: do you have standard net terms (Net 30/45)? Any specific invoice notes / PO fields we need to include?
- Billing entity name and address, and the AP contact (email/phone).
- Tax/VAT requirements: do you need VAT invoice format or a tax ID on file?
- Any vendor onboarding forms or W-9 / local equivalent needed from our side?

I attached our standard invoice template and a draft SOW to speed reviews. If it helps, we can loop in our finance ops (Rishi) to answer vendor setup questions directly.

Next steps we recommend: once you confirm the procurement path and billing info, we’ll draft the commercial order and provide the vendor paperwork for your AP team.

Best —
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com

Thanks Sara — this is perfect. I’ve attached the invoice template and the draft SOW to the thread for your AP team to preview (same attachments from my initial email).

To answer your questions:
- We can accept PO-based purchases. Our standard hosted API invoices are generally Net 30, but we can support Net 45 for Enterprise deals — I’ve copied Rishi to confirm and to start the vendor setup packet.
- W-9 and vendor setup: Rishi will share our standard vendor packet (W-9, vendor setup form, and remit details).
- AWS Marketplace: if you prefer consolidated cloud billing, we can offer a Marketplace SKU — note that Marketplace may affect billing cadence and contract terms (we can outline tradeoffs).

Next steps (proposed):
1) Rishi to send vendor packet and confirm net terms.
2) Acme to confirm PO process and provide a sample PO or PO requirements fields.
3) Redwood to issue draft commercial order matching the SOW and billing terms for your AP review.

Rishi — can you share the vendor package and confirm we’re okay to support Net 45 for this deal?

Best,
Marissa

- Billing address (for invoice header):

  400 Market St
  San Francisco, CA 94105

- AP contact / remit email: finance@acme-corp.com
